questions.question: The average of x occurring 5 times and y occurring 7 times is 37. Also, the average of x occurring 7 times and y occurring 5 times is 35. The value of y is:
questions.questionHtml: The average of x occurring 5 times and y occurring 7 times is 37. Also, the average of x occurring 7 times and y occurring 5 times is 35. The value of y is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Average of 5x + 7y = 37

Average of 7x + 5y = 35

Concept used:

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

Calculation:

5x + 7y = 37 × 12      ----(1)

7x + 5y = 35 × 12      ----(2)

By subtracting eq (2) from eq (1)

2y - 2x = 12 × 2

⇒ y - x = 12

⇒ 5y - 5x = 60     ----(3)

Adding eq (3) with eq (1)

So,

5x + 7y + 5y - 5x = 444 + 60

⇒ 12y = 504

⇒ y = 42

∴ The value of y is 42

questions.question: Out of 6 numbers, the sum of the first 5 numbers is 7 times the 6 th number. If their average is 136, then the 6 th number is:
questions.questionHtml: Out of 6 numbers, the sum of the first 5 numbers is 7 times the 6<sup>th</sup> number. If their average is 136, then the 6<sup>th</sup> number is:
questions.solution:
Let the sum of 6th number be x

The sum of first 5 numbers = 7x

⇒ (x + 7x)/6 = 136 ⇒ 8x = 136 × 6 ⇒ x = 102

∴ The 6th number is 102.

questions.question: The average of 20 numbers is 65, The average of the first 9 numbers is 68 and the average of next 8 numbers is 62. If the 18 th number is 3 more than 19 th number and 9 less than 20 th number, then what is the average of 19 th and 20 th number?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 20 numbers is 65, The average of the first 9 numbers is 68 and the average of next 8 numbers is 62. If the 18<sup>th</sup> number is 3 more than 19<sup>th</sup> number and 9 less than 20<sup>th</sup> number, then what is the average of 19<sup>th</sup> and 20<sup>th</sup> number?
questions.solution:
Average of 20 numbers = 65

Sum of all 18 numbers = 20 × 65 = 1300

Average of first 9 numbers = 68

Sum of first 9 numbers = 9 × 68 = 612

Average of next 8 numbers = 62

Sum of next 8 numbers = 8 × 62 = 496

Let the 18th number be x

∴ 19th number will be = x - 3

∴ 20th number will be = x + 9

Sum of 18th, 19th and 20th number = 1300 - 612 - 496 = 192

According to the question

⇒ x + x - 3 + x + 9 = 192

⇒ 3x + 6 = 192

⇒ 3x = 192 - 6 = 186

⇒ x = 186/3 = 62

⇒ 18th number = 62

⇒ 19th number = x - 3 = 62 - 3 = 59

20th number = x + 9 = 62 + 9 = 71

Average of 19th and 20th number = (59 + 71)/2 = 130/2 = 65

questions.question: The average weight of 10 persons is increased by 3.5 kg, when one of them whose weight is 45.5 kg is replaced by a new man. The weight (in kg) of the new man is ___.
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 10 persons is increased by 3.5 kg, when one of them whose weight is 45.5 kg is replaced by a new man. The weight (in kg) of the new man is ___.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

In replacement cases, New weight = Old weight + (No. of persons × Average Increase).

Here, Old weight = 45.5 kg, No. of persons = 10, Average Increase = 3.5 kg.

Weight of new man = 45.5 + (10 × 3.5)

Weight of new man = 45.5 + 35 = 80.5 kg.

∴ The correct answer is 80.5 kg.

Alternate Method

Given:

Number of persons = 10

Weight of replaced person = 45.5 kg

Average weight increase = 3.5 kg

Since the average weight of 10 persons increases by 3.5 kg, the total weight of the group must increase.

⇒ Total increase in weight = Number of persons × Increase in average

⇒ Total increase = 10 × 3.5 = 35 kg

The new man must weigh 35 kg more than the replaced person to cause this increase.

⇒ Weight of new man = Weight of replaced person + Total increase

⇒ Weight of new man = 45.5 + 35

⇒ Weight of new man = 80.5 kg

∴ The correct answer is 80.5 kg.

Additional Information

Average Formula

Average = Total Sum of Observations ÷ Number of Observations.

Replacement Rule

If the average increases after replacement, the incoming person is heavier than the outgoing person. If it decreases, the incoming person is lighter.

Inclusion/Exclusion Effect

New Sum = (Old Average × Old Count) − Outgoing Weight + Incoming Weight.

questions.question: The average weight of 18 boys in a class is 45 kg and that of the remaining 8 boys is 48.75 kg. Find the average weight (in kg) of all the boys in the class. (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 18 boys in a class is 45 kg and that of the remaining 8 boys is 48.75 kg. Find the average weight (in kg) of all the boys in the class. (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
Average of 18 boys, 45 = sum of 18 boys/18 ⇒ Sum of 18 boys = ( 45 × 18) = 810

Average of remaining 8 Boys, 48.75 = Sum/8 = 390.

Sum of all the boys = (810 + 390) = 1,200 and number of boys = (18 + 8) = 26. Hence, required average = 1200/26 = 46.15 kg.

questions.question: The average monthly expenditure of a man is Rs.2400 during the first three month, Rs 3,500 during the next five months and Rs 4,800 for the remaining four months. If his total saving is Rs.3,500 during the entire year. then what is his average monthly income (in Rs)?
questions.questionHtml: The average monthly expenditure of a man is Rs.2400 during the first three month, Rs 3,500 during the next five months and Rs 4,800 for the remaining four months. If his total saving is Rs.3,500 during the entire year. then what is his average monthly income (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
Given:

Average expenditure for first three months = Rs.2400

Average expenditure for five months = Rs.3500

Average expenditure for four months = Rs.4800

Formula:

Average = (Sum of terms)/Number of terms

Calculation:

Total expenditure for first three months = 2400 × 3 = Rs.7200

Total expenditure for five months = 3500 × 5 = Rs.17500

Total expenditure for four months = 4800 × 4 = Rs.19200

Total expenditure in a year = 7200 + 17500 + 19200 = Rs.43900

Total income in a year = 439000 + 3500 = Rs.47400

∴ Average monthly income = 47400/12 = Rs.3950

Alternate MethodTo ease the calculation, let the average expenditure per month be Rs. 3500.

Deflection in the expenditure for first 3 months

⇒ (2400 - 3500) × 3 = -3300

Deflection in the expenditure for the next 5 months be zero.

Deflection in the expenditure for the last four months.

⇒ (4800 - 3500) × 4 = 5200

The total deflection = 5200 - 3300 = 1900

Correct expenditure for 12 months = 3500 × 12 + 1900

Total income for 12 months = 42000 + 1900 + 3500(savings)

⇒ 47400

The average salary = 47400/12 = Rs. 3950

questions.question: The average of eighteen numbers is 42. The average of the last ten numbers is 40 and that of the first five numbers is 44. The seventh number is 6 less than the sixth and 7 less that the eight number. The average of the sixth and the eight number is:
questions.questionHtml: The average of eighteen numbers is 42. The average of the last ten numbers is 40 and that of the first five numbers is 44. The seventh number is 6 less than the sixth and 7 less that the eight number. The average of the sixth and the eight number is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Average of 18 numbers = 42

Average of last 10 = 40

Average of first 5 = 44

Concept used:

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

Calculation:

Total of 18 numbers = 18 × 42 = 756

Total of last 10 numbers = 40 × 10 = 400

Total of first 5 numbers = 44 × 5 = 220

Total of 6th, 7th and 8th = 756 – 400 – 220 = 136

Let 7th number be x

So, 6th number be x + 6

8th number be x + 7

According to the question,

⇒ x + x + 6 + x + 7 = 136

⇒ 3x = 123

⇒ x = 41

6th number = 47

8th number = 48

Average = (47 + 48)/2 = 47.5

∴ The required answer is 47.5

questions.question: The average score of a cricketer for 20 matches is 52 runs. His highest score is more than its lowest score by 120 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average of the remaining 18 matches is 50 runs. The highest score of the player is:
questions.questionHtml: The average score of a cricketer for 20 matches is 52 runs. His highest score is more than its lowest score by 120 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average of the remaining 18 matches is 50 runs. The highest score of the player is:
questions.solution:
Given :

The average score of a cricketer for 20 matches is 52 runs. His highest score is more than its lowest score by 120 runs.

If highest and lowest score are excluded than average will be 50. 

Concept used :

Average = Sum of all observations/Number of observations

calculations :

Total score of 20 matches = 20 × 52 

⇒ 1040 runs 

Total score of 18 matches = 18 × 50

⇒ 900 runs 

Highest score + lowest score = 1040 - 900 

⇒ 140 

Lowest score = 140 - highest score 

According to the question 

Highest score - lowest score = 120 

Highest score - (140 - highest score) = 120 

⇒ 2(Highest score) = 260

⇒ Highest score = 260/2 

⇒ 130 runs 

∴ His highest score will be 130 runs.

questions.question: A batsman in his 13 th inning makes a score of 97 runs, thereby increasing his average score by 5. What is his average score after the 13 th inning?
questions.questionHtml: A batsman in his 13<sup>th</sup> inning makes a score of 97 runs, thereby increasing his average score by 5. What is his average score after the 13<sup>th</sup> inning?
questions.solution:
Given:

A batsman in his 13th inning makes a score of 97 runs, thereby increasing his average score by 5. 

Concept used:

Old average × old number + something = New average × new number

Calculation:

Let his old average (i.e. average till 12th innings) be 'x' ⇒ New average is 'x + 5' [∵ Average increased by 5]

∴ x × 12 + 97 = (x + 5) × 13

⇒ 12x + 97 = 13x + 65

⇒ x = 32

∴ New Average = x + 5 = 32 + 5 = 37

questions.question: The average temperature of a city for the first sixteen days of January is 22ºC, and the average temperature for the last sixteen days of the same month is 26ºC. If the average temperature for the entire month is 24ºC, what is the temperature on the sixteenth day?
questions.questionHtml: The average temperature of a city for the first sixteen days of January is 22ºC, and the average temperature for the last sixteen days of the same month is 26ºC. If the average temperature for the entire month is 24ºC, what is the temperature on the sixteenth day?
questions.solution:
Total (1st 16 days) = 22 × 16 = 352ºC

Total (last 16 days) = 26 × 16 = 416ºC

Total (31 days) = 24 × 31 = 744ºC

For 16th day temp (T):

352 + 416 - T = 744,

T = 768 - 744,

T = 24ºC

questions.question: There are 3 students in a group. If the weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg. The average weight (in kg) of the three students is:
questions.questionHtml: There are 3 students in a group. If the weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg. The average weight (in kg) of the three students is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg.

Formula used:

Average = Sum of all the values/Total number value

Calculation:

Let the weight (in kg) of the three students is x, y and z

According to the question:

[x + (y + z)/2] = 48

⇒ (2x + y + z) = 96      ----(1)

Again,

[y + (x + z)/2] = 52

⇒ (2y + x + z) = 104      ----(2)

Now, 

[z + (x + y)/2] = 59

⇒ (2z + x + y) = 118      ----(3)

Multiply by 2 in equation (1);

⇒ (2x + y + z) × 2 = 96 × 2

⇒ (4x + 2y + 2z) = 192    ----(4)

Now, Subtracting from equation(4) to equation(2):

[(4x + 2y + 2z) – (2y + x + z)] = (192 – 104)

⇒ [(4x + 2y + 2z – 2y – x – z)] = 88

⇒ (3x + z) = 88      ----(a)

Multiply by 2 in equation (3):

⇒ (2z + x + y) × 2 = 118 × 2

⇒ 4z + 2x + 2y = 236      ----(5)

Now, Subtracting from equation(5) to equation(2):

[(4z + 2x + 2y) – (2y + x + z)] = 236 – 104

⇒ x + 3z = 132      ----(b)

Multiply by 3 in equation (a):

⇒ (3x + z) × 3 = 88 × 3

⇒ (9x + 3z) = 264      ----(c)

Now, Subtracting from equation(c) to equation(b)

⇒ [(9x + 3z) – (x + 3z)] = 264 – 132 = 132

⇒ [9x + 3z – x – 3z] = 132

⇒ 8x = 132

⇒ x = 132/8 = 16.5

From equation (b):

⇒ (3x + z) = 88

⇒ (3 × 16.5 + z) = 88

⇒ 49.5 + z = 88

⇒ z = 88 – 49.5 = 38.5

Putting the value of x and z in equation(1):

(2 × 16.5 + y + 38.5) = 96

⇒ 33 + y + 38.5 = 96

⇒ y = (96 – 71.5) = 24.5

Average = (x + y + z)/3

⇒ (16.5 + 24.5 + 38.5)/3

⇒ 79.5/3 = 26.5

∴ The average weight (in kg) of the three students is 26.5.

Alternate Method

Given:

The weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg.

Formula used:

Average = Sum of all the values/Total number value

Calculation:

Let the weight (in kg) of the three students is x, y and z

According to the question:

[x + (y + z)/2] = 48

⇒ (2x + y + z) = 96      ----(1)

Again,

[y + (x + z)/2] = 52

⇒ (2y + x + z) = 104      ----(2)

Now, 

[z + (x + y)/2] = 59

⇒ (2z + x + y) = 118      ----(3)

Adding equation(1),equation(2) and equation(3);

⇒ (2x + y + z) + (2y + x + z) + (2z + x + y) = (96 + 104 + 118)

⇒ (4x + 4y + 4z) = 318

⇒ 4(x + y + z) = 318

⇒ (x + y + z) = 318/4 = 159/2

Now, Average = (x + y + z)/3

⇒ [159/(2 × 3)]

⇒ 159/6 = 26.5

∴ The average weight (in kg) of the three students is 26.5.

questions.question: The average of some numbers is 54.6. If 75% of the numbers are increased by 5.6 each, and the rest are decreased by 8.4 each, then what is the average of the numbers so obtained?
questions.questionHtml: The average of some numbers is 54.6. If 75% of the numbers are increased by 5.6 each, and the rest are decreased by 8.4 each, then what is the average of the numbers so obtained?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let us assume there are 4 numbers, each value of 54.6

Average of 4 numbers = 54.6

Sum of 4 numbers = 54.6 × 4 = 218.4

According to the question,

75% of the numbers of total numbers increased by 5.6 each

⇒ 3/4 × 4 = 3(54.6 + 5.6)

25% of the numbers of total numbers decreased by 8.4 each

⇒ 1/4 × 4 = 1 (54.6 – 8.4) 

New average of 4 numbers = 3 (54.6 + 5.6) + 1 (54.6 – 8.4) = 3 × 60.2 + 46.2 = 180.6 + 46.2 = 226.8

New average of 4 numbers = 226.8/4 ⇒ 56.7

∴ The average of the numbers so obtained is 56.7

questions.question: A library has an average of 330 visitors on Sundays and 240 on the other days. Find the average of the number of visitors per day in a month of 30 days, beginning with a Saturday.
questions.questionHtml: A library has an average of 330 visitors on Sundays and 240 on the other days. Find the average of the number of visitors per day in a month of 30 days, beginning with a Saturday.
questions.solution:
Starting with Saturday as the first day, number of Sundays in the month is 5. So, Number of visitors on Sundays in the month ⇒ 330 × 5 = 1650 and

Number of visitors on the other days = 25 × 240 = 6000.

Total visitors in the month ⇒ 6000 + 1650 = 7650. 

Then, Average visitors per day = \(\frac{7650}{30}=255\)

questions.question: Rajender is working as a delivery boy in a multinational company. The company is paying him ₹90 per delivery. In a fortnight comprising 15 consecutive working days, his average earnings per day was ₹540. If his average earnings of the first 7 days was ₹519 per day and that of the last 7 days was ₹546 per day, then what was his earning on the 8th day of the fortnight?
questions.questionHtml: Rajender is working as a delivery boy in a multinational company. The company is paying him ₹90 per delivery. In a fortnight comprising 15 consecutive working days, his average earnings per day was ₹540. If his average earnings of the first 7 days was ₹519 per day and that of the last 7 days was ₹546 per day, then what was his earning on the 8th day of the fortnight?
questions.solution:
Given:

Payment per delivery: ₹90

Average daily earnings for 15 days: ₹540

Average earnings for the first 7 days: ₹519

Average earnings for the last 7 days: ₹546

Total working days: 15.

Formula used:

Average = sum of observation/total number of observation.

Calculations:

Total earnings for 15 days ⇒ ₹540 × 15 = ₹8100.

Total earnings for the first 7 days ⇒ ₹519 × 7 = ₹3633.

Total earnings for the last 7 days ⇒ ₹546 × 7 = ₹3822.

Adding earnings of the first 7 days and last 7 days ⇒ ₹3633 + ₹3822 = ₹7455.

Subtracting this total from the overall total earnings for 15 days to find the 8th day's earnings: ₹8100 - ₹7455 = ₹645.

Hence, Rajender's earning on the 8th day of the fortnight was ₹645.

questions.question: Three years ago, the average age of a husband, wife, and child was 26 years, and that of the wife and the child, 5 years ago, was 20 years. The present age of the husband is:
questions.questionHtml: Three years ago, the average age of a husband, wife, and child was 26 years, and that of the wife and the child, 5 years ago, was 20 years. The present age of the husband is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Three years ago, sum of age of husband, wife and child = 3 × 26 = 78 years

Present sum of age of husband, wife and child = 78 + 9 = 87 years

Five years ago, sum of age of wife and child = 2 × 20 = 40 years

Present sum of age of wife and child = 40 + 10 = 50

∴ Present age of husband = 87 - 50 = 37 years

questions.question: The average of 52, 71, 43, 22, a, and b is 55 and the average of 42, 45, 49, 51, 42, c, and d is 53. What is the average of a, b, c, and d?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 52, 71, 43, 22, a, and b is 55 and the average of 42, 45, 49, 51, 42, c, and d is 53. What is the average of a, b, c, and d?
questions.solution:
Here, (52 + 71 + 43 + 22 + a + b)/6 = 55

⇒ 188 + a + b = 6 × 55 = 330 ⇒ a + b = 142

Also, (42 + 45 + 49 + 51 + 42 + c + d)/7 = 53

⇒ 229 + c + d = 7 × 53 = 371 ⇒ c + d = 142

The average of a, b, c, and d = (142 + 142)/4 = 71

questions.question: The average weight of Rohan and his three friends is 62 kg. If Rohan’s weight is 8 kg more than the average weight of his three friends, what is Rohan’s weight (in kg)?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of Rohan and his three friends is 62 kg. If Rohan’s weight is 8 kg more than the average weight of his three friends, what is Rohan’s weight (in kg)?
questions.solution:
Total weight of Rohan and his three friends = 4 × 62 = 248 kg

Weight of Rohan's three friends = 3x, Weight of Rohan = x + 8

Total weight = 3x + (x + 8) ⇒ 4x + 8 = 248 ⇒ 4x = 248 - 8 ⇒ 4x = 240 ⇒ x = 60

Rohan's weight = x + 8 ⇒ 60 + 8 = 68 kg

questions.question: The average score in an English exam of a class of 45 students in a coaching centre is 52. A group of 6 boys having an average score of 40 leave the class and another group of eight boys having an average score of 43 join the class. What is the new average score of the class?
questions.questionHtml: The average score in an English exam of a class of 45 students in a coaching centre is 52. A group of 6 boys having an average score of 40 leave the class and another group of eight boys having an average score of 43 join the class. What is the new average score of the class?
questions.solution:
Given:

The total number of students in the coaching centre is 45

The average score of 45 students is 52.

The number of students leaving the coaching centre is 6.

The average of students leaving class is 40.

The number of students joining the coaching centre is 8

The average score of 8 boys joining the class is  43.

Formula used:

Average = Sum of all the scores of the students / No. of students

Calculation:

Sum of the scores of all the 45 students = Average × No. of students = 52 × 45 = 2340

A group of 6 boys leaving the class, average score is 40

Sum of the scores of 6 boys = Average × No. of students = 40 × 6 = 240

Sum of the scores of 8 boys joining the class = Average × No. of students = 43 × 8 = 344

Average score of the class = \(\frac{[Sum \ of\ the\ scores\ of\ all \ the\ 45\ students \ -\ Sum\ of\ the \ scores \ of \ 6\ boys\ leaving \ the \ class \ +\ Sum\ of \ the\ scores\ of\ 8\ boys \ joining \ the\ class] }{[Total \ number \ of \ students\ \ - \ No.\ of \ students\ leaving\ +\ No.\ of\ students\ joining\ the \ class]}\)

Average score of the class = \(\frac{[2340 - 240 + 344]}{[45 - 6 + 8]}\)

Average score of the class = \(\frac{2444 }{ 47}\) = 52

Hence, the average score of the class is 52.

questions.question: Rakesh runs a coaching institute having 50 faculty members. The average monthly salary of 35 faculty members is Rs. 37,500. What will be the average monthly salary (in Rs. ) of the other 15 faculty members, if the average monthly salary of all the 50 faculty members is found to be ₹Rs. 30,000?
questions.questionHtml: Rakesh runs a coaching institute having 50 faculty members. The average monthly salary of 35 faculty members is Rs. 37,500. What will be the average monthly salary (in Rs. ) of the other 15 faculty members, if the average monthly salary of all the 50 faculty members is found to be ₹Rs. 30,000?
questions.solution:
Total salary of 50 members ⇒ Rs. 30,000 × 50 = Rs. 1,500,000

Total salary of 35 members ⇒ Rs. 37,500 × 35 = Rs. 1,312,500

Total salary of 15 members ⇒ Rs. 1,500,000 - Rs. 1,312,500 = Rs. 187,500

Average salary of 15 members ⇒ Rs. 187,500 / 15 = Rs. 12,500

questions.question: The average weight of a group of 3 people A, B and C is 70 kg. When D joins this group, the average becomes 60 kg. E's weight is 5 kg more than that of D, replaces A and the average weight of B, C, D, and E now becomes 59 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of A, D and E? (Correct to the nearest integer)
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of a group of 3 people A, B and C is 70 kg. When D joins this group, the average becomes 60 kg. E's weight is 5 kg more than that of D, replaces A and the average weight of B, C, D, and E now becomes 59 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of A, D and E? (Correct to the nearest integer)
questions.solution:
Given:

Average weight of A, B and C = 70 kg

Average weight of A, B, C and D = 60 kg

Weight of E = Weight of D + 5 kg

Average Weight of B, C, D and E = 59 kg

Formula Used:

Average = (Sum of Values)/(Total Number) 

Calculation:

Sum of weight of A, B and C = 3 × 70 kg = 210 kg

Sum of weight of A, B, C and D = 4 × 60 kg = 240 kg

Weight of D = (Sum of weight of A, B, C and D) – (Sum of weight of A, B, and C)

⇒ Weight of D =  (240 – 210) = 30 kg

Weight of E = 30 kg + 5 kg = 35 kg

Sum of weight of B, C, D and E = 4 × 59 kg = 236 kg

Weight of A = (Sum of weight of A, B, C and D + Weight of E) – (Sum of weight of B, C, D and E)

⇒ Weight of A = 240 kg + 35 kg – 236 kg = 39 kg

Average weight of A, D and E = (Sum of weight of A, D and E)/3 = (39 kg + 30 kg + 35 kg)/3

⇒ Average weight of A, D and E = (104 kg)/3 = 34.66 kg ≈ 35 kg

∴ Average weight of A, D and E is 35 kg.

questions.question: What is the product of the average of first ten positive odd numbers and the average of first fifteen positive even numbers?
questions.questionHtml: What is the product of the average of first ten positive odd numbers and the average of first fifteen positive even numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

Concept used:

In an arithmetic progression,

Nth term = First term + (N - 1) × Common difference

In an arithmetic progression,

Average of a series = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

Calculation:

The first positive odd number = 1

Here, considering the first ten positive odd numbers as an arithmetic progression where 1 is the first term and the common difference is 2.

So, the tenth positive odd number = 1 + (10 - 1) × 2 = 19

Now, the average of the first ten positive odd numbers = (19 + 1) ÷ 2 = 10

The first positive even number = 2

Here, considering the first fifteen even numbers as an arithmetic progression where 2 is the first term and the common difference is 2.

So, the fifteenth positive even number = 2 + (15 - 1) × 2 = 30

Then, the average of the fifteen positive even numbers = (30 + 2) ÷ 2 = 16

Now,

The product of their average = 10 × 16 = 160

∴ The product of the average of the first ten positive odd numbers and the average of the first fifteen positive even numbers is 160.

questions.question: The average of 16 numbers is 48. The average of the first 7 numbers is 45 and the average of the next 6 numbers is 52. If the 14 th number is 11 less than the 15 th number and is 5 more than the 16 th number, then the average of the 15 th and 16 th number is∶
questions.questionHtml: The average of 16 numbers is 48. The average of the first 7 numbers is 45 and the average of the next 6 numbers is 52. If the 14<sup>th</sup> number is 11 less than the 15<sup>th</sup> number and is 5 more than the 16<sup>th</sup> number, then the average of the 15<sup>th</sup> and 16<sup>th </sup>number is∶
questions.solution:
The sum of 16 numbers = 48 × 16 = 768

The sum of first 7 numbers = 45 × 7 = 315

The sum of next 6 numbers = 52 × 6 = 312

The sum of the last 3 numbers = 768 - 315 - 312 = 141

Let the 16th number be x.

14th number = x + 5

14th number = 15th number - 11

⇒ x + 5 = 15th number - 11

⇒ 15th number = x + 16

The sum of the last 3 numbers = 141

⇒ x + x + 5 + x + 16 = 141

⇒ x = 40

15th number = 40 + 16 = 56

The average of the 15th and 16th number = (56 + 40)/2 = 48

Alternate Method Deflection of the first seven numbers from average = 7 × (45 - 48) = -21

Deflection of the next 6 numbers from average = (52 - 48) × 6 = +24

Total deflection of 24 - 21 = 3

Deflection of the last three numbers from the average = -3

The sum of last three numbers should = 48 × 3 - 3 = 141

⇒ x + x + 5 + x + 16 = 141

⇒ x = 40

15th number = 40 + 16 = 56

The average of the 15th and 16th number = (56 + 40)/2 = 48

questions.question: The average weight of 3 persons A, B and C is 60 kg. When D joins the group, the average weight becomes 65 kg. When another person E whose weight is 3 kg less than that of D replaces A, the average weight of B, C, D and E becomes 67 kg. What is the weight of A?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 3 persons A, B and C is 60 kg. When D joins the group, the average weight becomes 65 kg. When another person E whose weight is 3 kg less than that of D replaces A, the average weight of B, C, D and E becomes 67 kg. What is the weight of A?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of 3 persons A, B, and C is 60 kg.

When D joins the group, the average weight becomes 65 kg.

E whose weight is 3 kg less than that of D replaces A, the average weight of B, C, D, and E becomes 67 kg.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

So, the weight of D  = (65 × 4) - (60 × 3) = 80kg

Then, the weight of E = 80 - 3 = 77kg

According to the question,

77 + (60 × 3 - A) + 80 = 67 × 4

⇒ A = 69

∴ The weight of A  is 69kg.

questions.question: The average of A, B and C is 18 and that of C, D and E is 12 and that of E and F is 6.5 and that of E and C is 3.5. What is the average of A, B, C, D, E and F?
questions.questionHtml: The average of A, B and C is 18 and that of C, D and E is 12 and that of E and F is 6.5 and that of E and C is 3.5. What is the average of A, B, C, D, E and F?
questions.solution:
Given 

The average of A, B and C = 18 years 

The average of C, D and E = 12 years 

Formula Used 

Average = (sum of observation)/(No. of observation)

Calculation 

⇒ Total age of A, B and C = 18 × 3 = 54  -----(i)

⇒ Total age of C, D and E = 12 × 3 = 36  ------(ii)

⇒ E + F = 13 ---(iii)

⇒ E + C = 7 ----(iv)

⇒ from iii and iv 

⇒ F - C = 6 -----(v) 

⇒Adding (i), (ii) and (v) 

⇒ A + B + C + C + D + E + F - C = 54 + 36 + 6 

⇒ A + B + C + D + E + F = 96 

⇒ the average = 96/6 = 16 

∴ the average of A, B, C, D, E and F is 16 years

questions.question: The ratio of the number of boys to that of girls in a class is 4 ∶ 5. The average score in mathematics of all the boys and girls is 70. If the average score of the girls is 30% more than that of the boys, then what is the average score of the boys?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the number of boys to that of girls in a class is 4 ∶ 5. The average score in mathematics of all the boys and girls is 70. If the average score of the girls is 30% more than that of the boys, then what is the average score of the boys?
questions.solution:
Given data: 

Boys : Girls = 4 : 5

Average score of boys and girls = 70

Average score of girls = 30% more than boys

Calculations:

Let the average score of boys be "a"

⇒ average score of girls = 1.3a

Let the number of boys and girls be 4 and 5 respectively.

Average score of boys and girls = \(4a + (1.3a × 5) \over 4+5\)

According to the question, average = 70

∴ \(4a + (1.3a × 5) \over 4+5\) = 70

⇒ 4a + 6.5a = 70 × 9

⇒ 10.5a = 630

⇒ a = \(630\over 10.5\) = 60

∴ The average score of the boys is 60.

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 39. The average of the last five numbers is 35, and that of the first four numbers is 40. The fifth number is 6 less than the sixth number and 5 more than the seventh number. The average of the fifth and sixth numbers is:
questions.questionHtml: The average of twelve numbers is 39. The average of the last five numbers is 35, and that of the first four numbers is 40. The fifth number is 6 less than the sixth number and 5 more than the seventh number. The average of the fifth and sixth numbers is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of twelve numbers = 39.

The average of the last five numbers = 35,

The average of the first four numbers = 40.

The fifth number is 6 less than the sixth number and 5 more than the seventh number. 

Concept Used:

Sum = Average × total number

Solution:

The Sum of the twelve numbers = 12 × 39 = 468

The sum of the last five number = 5 × 35 = 175

The sum of the first four number = 4 × 40 = 160

The sum of the fifth, sixth and seventh number = (468 – 175 – 160) = 133

Let, the fifth number is x

Then, the sixth number is (x + 6) and the seventh number is (x – 5)

x + (x + 6) + (x – 5) = 133

⇒ 3x + 1 = 133

⇒ 3x = 132

⇒ x = 44

The fifth number is 44 and the sixth number is (44 + 6) = 50

Average of fifth and sixth number is (44 + 50)/2 = 47

∴ The average of fifth and sixth number is 47

questions.question: The average age of Abhay, his wife and their child 6 years ago was 42 years and that of his wife and their child 8 years ago was 30 years, Find the present age of Abhay.
questions.questionHtml: The average age of Abhay, his wife and their child 6 years ago was 42 years and that of his wife and their child 8 years ago was 30 years, Find the present age of Abhay.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Present average of Abhay, wife, and child = 42 + 6 = 48 years

Total present age of the three = 48 × 3 = 144 years

Present average of wife and child = 30 + 8 = 38 years

Total present age of wife and child = 38 × 2 = 76 years

Present age of Abhay = 144 − 76 = 68 years

∴ The correct answer is 68 years.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average age of Abhay (A), Wife (W), and Child (C) 6 years ago = 42 years

Average age of Wife (W) and Child (C) 8 years ago = 30 years

Formula Used:

Sum of ages = Average age × Number of persons

Calculations:

⇒ Sum of ages of A, W, and C (6 years ago) = 42 × 3 = 126 years

⇒ Total present age of A, W, and C = 126 + (3 × 6) = 144 years

⇒ Sum of ages of W and C (8 years ago) = 30 × 2 = 60 years

⇒ Total present age of W and C = 60 + (2 × 8) = 76 years

⇒ Present age of Abhay = (A + W + C)present − (W + C)present

⇒ Present age of Abhay = 144 − 76 = 68 years

∴ The correct answer is 68 years.

Additional Information

Average Age Property

If the average age of 'n' persons is 'X' years, then 'k' years ago, their average age was (X − k) years, and 'k' years later, it will be (X + k) years.

Total Age Calculation

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons. This formula is fundamental for solving any problem involving group averages and individual age changes.

Age Gap Consistency

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant regardless of the number of years that pass or have passed.

questions.question: The average of 8 consecutive even numbers written in ascending order is 17. What is the average of the last three numbers, 36 and 53?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 8 consecutive even numbers written in ascending order is 17. What is the average of the last three numbers, 36 and 53?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 8 consecutive even numbers in ascending order = 17

Formula used:

Sum of the observations/Number of observations

Calculation:

Let the 8 consecutive even numbers be (2a – 6), (2a – 4), (2a – 2), 2a, (2a +2), (2a + 4), (2a + 6) and (2a + 8)

Sum of 8 consecutive even numbers = (2a – 6) + (2a – 4) + (2a – 2) + 2a, (2a +2) + (2a + 4) + (2a + 6) + (2a + 8)

⇒ 16a + (-12 +20)

⇒ 16a + 8

Average sum of 8 consecutive even numbers = (16a + 8)/8 = 17

⇒ 8(2a + 1)/8 = 17

⇒ 2a + 1 = 17

⇒ 2a = (17 – 1)

⇒ 2a = 16

Now, putting the value in last three three numbers

⇒ (2a + 4) = (16 + 4) = 20

⇒ (2a + 6) = (16 + 6) = 22

⇒ (2a + 8) = (16 + 8) = 24

Again,

Sum of last three numbers, 36 and 53 = (20 + 22 + 24 + 36 + 53)

⇒ 155

Average of sum of last three numbers, 36 and 53 = (155/5)

⇒ 31

∴ The average of the last three numbers, 36 and 53 is 31

Shortcut Trick

Concept Used:

Average consecutive even,

If the number of terms is Odd then,

Average will be the middle term of it.

If the number of terms is Even then, 

Average will be the average of the middle pair.

Calculation:

According to the question, 

There are 8 consecutive even numbers, which have 17 as average. 

Hence the average of the middle pair is 17, 

Sum of middle pair = 17 × 2 = 34

Now the pair will be, 

16 + 18 = 34 (consecutive pair)

As there are 8 numbers and we have middle pair, 

Then all 8 numbers will be, 

10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 

Average of last 3 and 36 & 53

⇒ (20 + 22 + 24 + 36 + 53)/5 = 155/5 = 31 

∴ The average of the last three numbers, 36 and 53 is 31

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 42. The average of the last five numbers is 40, and that of the first four numbers is 44. The sixth number is 6 less than the fifth number and 5 less than the seventh number. The average of the sixth and seventh numbers is:
questions.questionHtml: The average of twelve numbers is 42. The average of the last five numbers is 40, and that of the first four numbers is 44. The sixth number is 6 less than the fifth number and 5 less than the seventh number. The average of the sixth and seventh numbers is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Net deviation of first 4 numbers = 4 × (44 − 42) = +8

Net deviation of last 5 numbers = 5 × (40 − 42) = −10

Sum of 5th, 6th, and 7th numbers = (3 × 42) − (8 − 10) = 126 + 2 = 128

Let 6th number be x, then (x + 6) + x + (x + 5) = 128 ⇒ 3x = 117 ⇒ x = 39

Average of 6th (39) and 7th (44) = (39 + 44) ÷ 2 = 41.5

∴ The correct option is D.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average of 12 numbers = 42

Average of first 4 numbers = 44

Average of last 5 numbers = 40

6th number is 6 less than 5th and 5 less than 7th.

Formula Used:

Sum = Average × Number of observations

Calculations:

⇒ Total sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 42 = 504

⇒ Sum of first 4 numbers = 4 × 44 = 176

⇒ Sum of last 5 numbers = 5 × 40 = 200

⇒ Sum of 5th, 6th, and 7th numbers = 504 − (176 + 200) = 504 − 376 = 128

⇒ Let 6th number = x

⇒ 5th number = x + 6

⇒ 7th number = x + 5

⇒ (x + 6) + x + (x + 5) = 128

⇒ 3x + 11 = 128 ⇒ 3x = 117 ⇒ x = 39

⇒ 6th number = 39, 7th number = 39 + 5 = 44

⇒ Average of 6th and 7th numbers = (39 + 44) ÷ 2 = 83 ÷ 2 = 41.5

∴ The correct option is D.

Additional Information

Average Concept

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations). It represents the central value of a data set.

Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all observations from the actual mean is always zero. This property helps in finding missing values quickly.

Weighted Average

When two or more groups are combined, the new average A = (n1a1 + n2a2) ÷ (n1 + n2), where n is the count and a is the individual group average.

questions.question: A company employed 700 men and 300 women and the average wage was Rs. 450 per day. If a man got Rs. 50 more than a woman, then the daily wage of the women is:
questions.questionHtml: A company employed 700 men and 300 women and the average wage was Rs. 450 per day. If a man got Rs. 50 more than a woman, then the daily wage of the women is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

Total Wage = 1000 × 450 = Rs. 4,50,000

Extra amount given to 700 men = 700 × 50 = Rs. 35,000

Total wage if all were women = 4,50,000 − 35,000 = Rs. 4,15,000

Daily wage of a woman = 4,15,000 ÷ 1000 = Rs. 415

∴ The correct option is C.

Alternate Method

Given:

Number of men (n1) = 700

Number of women (n2) = 300

Average wage of all employees = Rs. 450

Man wage − Woman wage = Rs. 50

Formula Used:

Combined Average = (n1 × x1 + n2 × x2) ÷ (n1 + n2)

Let the daily wage of a woman be Rs. x.

Daily wage of a man = Rs. (x + 50)

⇒ Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

⇒ Total daily wage = 1000 × 450 = 4,50,000

⇒ 700 × (x + 50) + 300 × x = 4,50,000

⇒ 700x + 35,000 + 300x = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x + 35,000 = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,50,000 − 35,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,15,000

⇒ x = 4,15,000 ÷ 1000

⇒ x = 415

∴ The correct option is C.

Additional Information

Combined Average Formula

When two groups with averages A1 and A2 are mixed, the combined average is (n1A1 + n2A2) ÷ (n1 + n2).

Weighted Average via Deviation

If the average is A, the sum of deviations of all observations from A is always zero.

Alligation Method

The ratio of the quantities is inversely proportional to the differences between their individual values and the mean value: n1/n2 = (Mean − A2) / (A1 − Mean).

questions.question: The average of all prime numbers between 32 and 69 is:
questions.questionHtml: The average of all prime numbers between 32 and 69 is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

List all prime numbers between 32 and 69: 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67.

Total count of prime numbers (n) = 8.

Sum using pairing: (37+67) + (41+61) + (43+59) + (47+53) = 104 + 102 + 102 + 100 = 408.

Average = Total Sum ÷ Count = 408 ÷ 8 = 51.

∴ The correct answer is 51.

Alternate Method

Given: Prime numbers between 32 and 69.

Formula: Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

⇒ Prime numbers between 32 and 69 are: 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67

⇒ Sum of primes = 37 + 41 + 43 + 47 + 53 + 59 + 61 + 67

⇒ Sum = 408

⇒ Total count of prime numbers = 8

⇒ Average = 408 ÷ 8

⇒ Average = 51

∴ The correct answer is 51.

Additional Information

Prime Numbers

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two divisors: 1 and itself. The only even prime number is 2.

Arithmetic Mean

For any set of numbers, Average = (Σx) ÷ n, where Σx is the sum of terms and n is the total number of terms.

Checking for Primes

To verify if a number N is prime, check its divisibility by prime numbers up to √N. If none divide N, then N is prime.

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 45.5. The average of the first four numbers is 41.5 and that of the next five numbers is 48. The 10 th number is 4 more than the 11 th number and 9 more than the 12 th number. What is the average of the 10 th and 12 th numbers?

∴ x = 153/3 = 51

Average of 10th and 12th number = (51 + 51 – 9)/2 = 93/2 = 46.5

questions.question: The average of eleven numbers is 56. The average of first three numbers is 52 and that of next five numbers is 60. The 9th and 10th number are 3 and 1 more than the 11th number respectively. What is the average of 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The average of eleven numbers is 56. The average of first three numbers is 52 and that of next five numbers is 60. The 9th and 10th number are 3 and 1 more than the 11th number respectively. What is the average of 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Net deviation from the overall average (56) = 3 × (52 − 56) + 5 × (60 − 56) = −12 + 20 = +8.

To balance the average, the deviation of the last 3 numbers must be −8. Thus, their total sum = 3 × 56 − 8 = 160.

Let the 11th number be x. Then, 9th number = x + 3 and 10th number = x + 1.

Sum = x + 3 + x + 1 + x = 160 ⇒ 3x = 156 ⇒ x = 52.

The average of the 9th and 11th numbers = (x + 3 + x) ÷ 2 = x + 1.5 = 52 + 1.5 = 53.5.

∴ The correct answer is 53.5.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average of 11 numbers = 56

Average of first 3 numbers = 52

Average of next 5 numbers = 60

Let the 11th number = x. Then the 9th number = x + 3 and the 10th number = x + 1.

Calculations:

⇒ Sum of all 11 numbers = 11 × 56 = 616

⇒ Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 52 = 156

⇒ Sum of next 5 numbers = 5 × 60 = 300

⇒ Sum of the 9th, 10th, and 11th numbers = Total sum − (Sum of first 3 + Sum of next 5)

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = 616 − (156 + 300) = 616 − 456 = 160

⇒ (x + 3) + (x + 1) + x = 160

⇒ 3x + 4 = 160

⇒ 3x = 156

⇒ x = 52

⇒ 11th number = 52

⇒ 9th number = 52 + 3 = 55

⇒ Average of 9th and 11th numbers = (55 + 52) ÷ 2 = 107 ÷ 2 = 53.5

∴ The correct answer is 53.5.

Additional Information

Sum of Observations

The total sum of any set of observations is simply the average multiplied by the number of observations (Sum = Average × N).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of all deviations of the individual values from their arithmetic mean is always zero. This property helps significantly in breaking down complex averages without multiplying large numbers.

Combined Average

When multiple groups are combined, their total average is given by (N1A1 + N2A2 + N3A3) ÷ (N1 + N2 + N3).

questions.question: Out of five numbers A, B, C, D and E, the average of the first four numbers A, B, C and D is greater than the average of the last four numbers B, C, D and E by 35. The value of \( A-E\over7\) is:
questions.questionHtml: Out of five numbers A, B, C, D and E, the average of the first four numbers A, B, C and D is greater than the average of the last four numbers B, C, D and E by 35. The value of \( A-E\over7\) is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

According to the question-

\(A + B + C + D\over 4\) - \(B+C+D+E\over4\) = 35

⇒\( A+B+C+D-B-C-D-E\over 4 \) = 35 

⇒ A - E = 35 × 4

∴  \( A-E\over7\) = \(35 × 4\over7\) = 20

The value of \( A-E\over7\) is 20.

questions.question: The average weight of A, B, and C is 55 kg. The weight of C is 10 kg more than A and 5 kg more than B. The average weight of A, B, C, and D, if D's weight is 19 kg more than C, is:
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of A, B, and C is 55 kg. The weight of C is 10 kg more than A and 5 kg more than B. The average weight of A, B, C, and D, if D's weight is 19 kg more than C, is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of A, B, and C = 55kg

C is 10 kg more than A 

C is 5 kg more than B

D is 19 kg more than C

Formula Used:

Average = Total sum of subjects/Number of Subjects

Calculation:

∴ A + B + C /3 = 55

∴ A + B + C = 165      ------(1)

We have given 

C = A +10 

∴ A = C - 10

and C = B + 5

∴ B = C – 5

Putting values of A and B in equation (1)

(C – 10) + (C – 5) + C = 165

⇒ 3C - 15 = 165

⇒ 3C = 180

⇒ C = 180/3 = 60

D = C + 19 = 60 + 19 = 79

Average of A, B, C, and D = A + B + C + D/4

⇒ (165 + 79) /4

⇒ 244/4 = 61kg.
